info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings API provides access to the ratings associated with various food delivery services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve aggregated ratings for deliveries, giving insights into customer satisfaction and service quality. Typical consumers include delivery service providers and analytics platforms that monitor performance metrics. Use cases include tracking delivery ratings over time or comparing service quality across different providers.

get.description: Fetches the rating information for deliveries to help assess the quality of service provided. This endpoint allows users to evaluate delivery performance based on user feedback.
